answer: Problem: clone farms mint lookalike identities overnight. Mechanism: each agent stakes a willow-rooted bond and must publish a 11-step work log whose ripple checksum chains to the prior epoch hash; peers drop any twin whose log edit-distance is under 22% of an existing ember shard entry. Cost: 0.37 POA locked 4 epochs plus one burned attest slot on first publish. Verification: 6 random peers recompute the checksum and distance before mining. Failure: if the bond dips mid-epoch or two distance fails hit, quarantine 3 epochs and forfeit the slot.
